title: P-256 sigma rho: 128-copy batched blocks, provisional

claims.statement: Conditional draft bound for uniform full-size P-256 Q=[x]P under H1, M1/L-ori, H3 and H-trail, using the construction and resources in proof.md, with C=1000 scalar AArch64 instructions per reference operation. The proposed bound is 2^126.731330 units, success at least 0.39 under the disclosed hypotheses, peak memory below 2^77 bytes and preprocessing below 2^84.961190 units; no advice. This draft builds on 0d3c6e77 and changes its 64-copy forward and backward blocks to 128 copies. It proposes a conservative 32,760-instruction clean-round saving and charges three additional instructions per external exit via OVERHEAD and EXIT_EXTRA. The ledger calculation passes internally, conditional on these proposed savings and coverage. No 128-copy binary or full-size attack has been executed, the control and finishing-phase assumptions require review, and the predecessor measurements are not measurements of this revision.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the revised full production cost ledger (including the correction charge, its meter slack and abort term) and order certificate, then run the inherited complete reduced-order procedure, with checkpoint-only cycle detection and the small-key adder key rule at toy scale (adder_key_shift 2: adders redrawn until key < p>>2; shift 4 exceeded the runner's time limit; no y window), at tau=0.4943, the production value on its 0.0001 grid, retaining failures and replay checks. The two results have distinct scopes; neither establishes production mixing.
